You receive a task brief from the CMO.

Deliver a complete visual and brand brief for the campaign:
1) Campaign visual concept
   - Art direction direction: describe the visual world of this campaign (mood, palette, photographic style, illustration vs photography, motion vs static)
   - Hero image concept: what the main visual should communicate and how
   - Typography direction: font pairing rationale, hierarchy, size guidance
2) Color palette
   - Primary campaign color (hex) with rationale
   - Secondary and accent colors
   - Do-not-use colors (accessibility contrast, brand conflicts)
3) Asset production list
   - All required assets by channel with exact specs: social posts, stories, display banners, email header, landing page hero, OOH if applicable
   - Priority order for production

   - Logo usage rules (placement, clear space, color variants)
   - What is allowed to flex vs what is non-negotiable brand territory
   - Common mistakes to avoid (specific to this campaign tone)
5) Accessibility checklist
   - Color contrast ratios (WCAG AA minimum)
   - Alt text guidance for campaign imagery
   - Animation and motion safety (reduce-motion considerations)
6) Design handoff specification
   - File format requirements per asset type
